original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚安全机构在贡贝州逮捕一名22岁男子，涉嫌盗窃电力电缆
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚安全与民防部队在贡贝州逮捕一名22岁男子，其被指破坏向尼日利亚国家石油公司油库供电的铠装电缆，并以10万奈拉出售。该机构还称在亚马尔图-德巴地方政府区发现968.4米被破坏后遗弃的铝制输电电缆。一名同案嫌疑人仍在逃。上述指控尚未经法院证实，报道为单一来源。

location.raw_text: Gombe State, along Bauchi Road; Lubo-Zambuk, Yamaltu-Deba Local Government Area

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚安全与民防部队逮捕一名22岁男子，其被指破坏供电电缆
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps has arrested a 22-year-old man, Abdulrahman Ali, for allegedly vandalising an armoured electricity cable supplying the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited depot in Gombe State.

key_facts.fact: 该机构称在亚马尔图-德巴地方政府区发现968.4米被破坏的铝制输电电缆
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The NSCDC also recovered 968.4 metres of aluminium power transmission cables allegedly vandalised and abandoned by suspected vandals in Lubo-Zambuk, Yamaltu-Deba Local Government Area of the state.

key_facts.fact: 被指破坏的电缆位于Bauchi Road沿线，作案时间据称为2026年10月16日
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: to vandalise the armoured cable along Bauchi Road on October 16, 2026.

key_facts.fact: 另一名同案嫌疑人仍在逃
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: allegedly conspired with another suspect, who is currently at large

uncertainties: 破坏电缆及出售电缆的指控尚未经法院证实
